title: OCaml Temporal Core bridge client configuration
description: Private, strict configuration document sent from the OCaml supervisor to the Rust Core bridge. The admission limits are optional additive fields (#796): the OCaml encoder omits each one left at its default, so a default client sends exactly the two-field document.

target_url.description: Runtime validators enforce the 65536-byte transport ceiling; JSON Schema length is character-based.

identity.description: Runtime validators enforce the 65536-byte transport ceiling; Core and Server enforce semantic identity rules.

max_pending_waits.description: Distinct exact runs that may be waited on at once; repeated waits on one run share a slot. Omitted means 64. Admission beyond it returns status 15 (RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED).

max_pending_starts.description: Distinct start request IDs that may be in flight at once; a retry with the same request ID shares its slot. Omitted means 64. Admission beyond it returns status 15 (RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED).

max_in_flight_calls.description: Submitted client calls of every kind that may be outstanding at once, each counted until its completion cell is retired. Omitted means 4096. Admission beyond it returns status 15 (RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED).
